550:t_1:255.en:
$$サックス$$
(Like Sergeant $$相良$$, I seem to have stopped thinking of him as a machine...)

550:t_1:259.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「In this operation, the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ will act as a diversion while a force centered on this ship retakes $$メリダ島$$ from $$アマルガム$$.」

550:t_1:260.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「You have already received the outline. Now Captain $$テスタロッサ$$, who is in charge of the operation, will address you.」

550:t_1:263.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Captain... Please address them.」

550:t_1:266.en:
$$テッサ$$
(...This battle may be the last for me and the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$...)

550:t_1:267.en:
$$テッサ$$
(If $$レナード$$ carries out his plan, $c itself could vanish from the world...)

550:t_1:268.en:
$$テッサ$$
(...Neither the world nor I have time for sentiment or anxiety...)

550:t_1:269.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Get a hold of yourself. Straighten your back, tuck in your chin... Don't let your eyes wander.)

550:t_1:270.en:
$$テッサ$$
(I am a leader full of talent and power... the witch of $$ミスリル$$ who has overcome every difficulty and tormented our enemies.)

550:t_1:271.en:
$$テッサ$$
(If I look down on them calmly as always and show perfect dignity, their anxiety and fear will...)

550:t_1:274.en:
$$テッサ$$
(I've done it now... This might be my last address to them...)

550:t_1:275.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Even if I wanted to see everyone's faces, choosing the hangar was a mistake...)

550:t_1:276.en:
$$テッサ$$
(I should take this chance to make every piece of hangar equipment cordless and keep the floor flat, with nothing to trip over...)

550:t_1:277.en:
$$テッサ$$
(...What am I thinking...!? Calm down. Regain your dignity, quickly...)

550:t_1:278.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Don't show your distress. Act perfectly calm, as though you did it on purpose... But who trips on purpose!?)

550:t_1:281.en:
$n
(Don't dump every awkward job on me like that. It's Captain $$テスタロッサ$$, so this is $$宗介$$'s job.)

550:t_1:283.en:
$$マオ$$
(Don't. This is $$テッサ$$'s chance to show what she's made of.)

550:t_1:284.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Quickly... Quickly...! I have to do something...!)

550:t_1:285.en:
$$テッサ$$
(I need a way to regain my dignity, a way to regain my dignity, a way to regain my dignity...)

550:t_1:286.en:
$$テッサ$$
(...There isn't one. There can't be...)

550:t_1:287.en:
$$テッサ$$
(I'm sure they're all disgusted with me. Look... Everyone is standing rigidly at attention, expressionless.)

550:t_1:292.en:
$$テッサ$$
(What are... those smiles...? They aren't even trying to hide their laughter...)

550:t_1:293.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Are they saying holding back their voices is their last shred of courtesy...?)

550:t_1:295.en:
$$テッサ$$
(...I'm an idiot... I thought I was carrying the world alone and put on this tragic act all by myself...)

550:t_1:296.en:
$$テッサ$$
(The battle and the world will go on... along with these dear friends.)

550:t_1:298.en:
$$マオ$$
(That's right. We've made it through crises like this so many times.)

550:t_1:299.en:
$$マオ$$
(So you should do what you always do too. Yes... just as always...)

550:t_1:301.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm sorry for showing you something so inauspicious before the operation.」

550:t_1:303.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'd rather thank you for showing us something so entertaining.」

550:t_1:305.en:
$$カレン$$
「You can do it, $$テッサ$$!」

550:t_1:306.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「We are waiting to hear your words, Captain.」

550:t_1:308.en:
$$テッサ$$
「As you have been informed, $$アマルガム$$, now $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s private organization, intends to cause a $$時空震動$$ on $$メリダ島$$...」

550:t_1:309.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And remake this world into the form it desires.」

550:t_1:312.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I cannot feel the distortion he claims exists in this world.」

550:t_1:313.en:
$$テッサ$$
「At the very least, the world here and now is the world we live in.」

550:t_1:314.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We have known sorrow and pain on the way here. I have felt regret and cursed my fate...」

550:t_1:315.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even so, I love this world, and I have no intention of letting anyone destroy it.」

550:t_1:316.en:
$$スザク$$
(This is a world worth loving...)

550:t_1:317.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(That's right... Even with our irreversible regrets, this is the present that leads to the future.)

550:t_1:318.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The key to $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$'s repair of space-time is $$千鳥かなめ$$, whom you all know.」

550:t_1:319.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I have told you she is a special being called a $$ウィスパード$$, but...」

550:t_1:320.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We believe her mind is now controlled by what is called the $$ウィスパリング$$, which sends information to the $$ウィスパード$$.」

550:t_1:321.en:
$$宗介$$
(So that is the cause of $$千鳥$$'s transformation...)

550:t_1:322.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We will now go to $$メリダ島$$ and rescue $$カナメ$$ to stop $$レナード$$'s ambitions.」

550:t_1:326.en:
$$テッサ$$
「While our battles with the Empire and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ remain unresolved, we are entering a battle with the world at stake...」

550:t_1:327.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Perhaps, even if we lose and $$レナード$$ repairs space-time, it will only create a parallel world.」

550:t_1:328.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But I believe that people... must not return to the past.」

550:t_1:329.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If that were allowed, it would mean the future had lost its meaning.」

550:t_1:333.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$テッサ$$... May I say something too?」
